touch-list-every-file-the-independent-us.text: Touch list: every file the independent-user journey edits, creates or deletes.

As the desk ordering merges, I read here every file this ticket edits, creates or deletes, and the shared surfaces it crosses, so that I can order the merge without opening the diff. The ticket is issue 381, pull request 433, stacked on PR 525. It covers the four runs of the mandate. A slice that needs a file not on this list asks before editing it.
